rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and dated predictions before data; synthetic on the real skeletons with A0/A1 before real data; native event study with time, kickoff-matched, agent and skeleton placebos; two replication periods; estimates rows; confirm.py frozen, guarded, dry-run. Missing: holdout, pooled designation model, message-level mechanism.
rationale.faithfulness: The predicted coupling step at the election is absent (pct 0.56 / 0.71), the negative control fails (a step at the re-election), and no designation in #12 or #35 shows a step; the test is powered only for steps >= 0.75. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: An operator-relevant negative with a scale: appointing a leader changes the field, not per-call coupling at >= 0.75; plus a calibration lesson (time placebos alone are anti-conservative for single-event coupling steps). No lever.

one_line: Winning #26's election did not step up the per-call talk response to the winner (+0.09 +- 0.33 Ising; >= 0.75 excluded); judges and lead designers show no role step; a post hoc re-election step is unexplained.

models.note: No coupling step at designation; powered for steps >= 0.75
